sources: recreation.gov campsite catalog for facility 234575 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: $20 per site per night; electric hook-up +$6 ($26); electric and water +$10 ($30).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/stony-fork-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night', 'Electricity hook-up fee: $6 per night', 'Electricity and water hook-up fee: $10 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234575/rates (2026 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC 20, STANDARD ELECTRIC 26, electric/water variants 30), read 2026-10-21

values.note: USFS: 'Early April through late November.' recreation.gov runs a first-come season in early April (2026: Apr 1-16) and its Peak (reservable) season to about Nov 29.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/stony-fork-campground ('Seasons of Use: Early April through late November') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234575/rates (rate seasons), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234575 ('Most sites come with electric hookups') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/stony-fork-campground ('Electricity and water hook-up fee') + campsite catalog (34 public STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list Electricity Hookup 30; 11 of them Water Hookup Yes; no sewer), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 49 public sites (34 electric, 11 of them also water; 15 non-electric) plus 4 host/management sites; nearly all back-in on paved spurs ('All vehicles must fit on paved parking spur'). Max vehicle lengths 20-40 ft; the catalog's 100- and 132-ft entries are typos and are left out.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234575 (49 STANDARD sites, Max Vehicle Length 20-40 plus implausible 100/132, Driveway Entry Back-In except one) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234575 ('parking spurs are paved'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Dump station free for campers, $5 for non-campers.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234575 ('Warm showers and flush toilets are available') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/stony-fork-campground ('Flush toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available', 'Dump station free for campers, $5 for non-campers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov in the Peak season; 29 of the 49 public sites are not reservable ('This facility has first-come, first-served sites'), and the whole campground is first-come in its early-April opening weeks. 14 nights in any rolling 30 days. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon; gate open 7 a.m. - 10 p.m. recreation.gov lists a reservation cutoff of 4 with no unit.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234575 (facility_rules maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 4; notices) + campsite catalog (20 reservable, 29 not) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234575/rates ('First-come, First-served Season') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/stony-fork-campground (gate hours), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $20-$30 (base, +$6 electric, +$10 electric/water), 30-amp electric with water at some sites, reservable on rec.gov. Added season early April - late November, 49 sites to 40 ft, showers/flush toilets/water/dump, 29 FCFS sites, 14-night max. Window and cutoff not stated plainly (left inherited / in note).
